description: PAI Sicilia - UNITA’ FISIOGRAFICA N° 5 - PORTO DI CATANIA – PUNTA CASTELLUCCIO (005) is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by sitr.regione.sicilia.it. The Physiographical Unit No 5 runs from north to south from the Port of Catania to Punta Castelluccio, for a total length of approximately 23,214 km and runs along the central Ionian coast of Sicily, including territories belonging to the provinces of Catania and Siracusa. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "PAI Sicilia – PHYSIOGRAPHICAL UNIT No 5 – PORT OF CATANIA – CASTELLUCCIO POINT (005)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include unita fisiografica, difesa del suolo, piano assetto idrogeologico, pai, bacino idrografico. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
